description: Job Records: submit one job reference with every payment in and out (amount, asset, counterparty, payment reference, the job reference each names) and the receipts you hold. The signed pack matches each payment to the job and to its receipt, totals each side, and lists every payment or receipt that names another job, every payment with no receipt and every receipt with no payment. Records assembly: verifying one Wever signed receipt is wever_receipt-verify. Verdict mismatches_found, gaps_found or complete. POST /api/job-receipt-pack. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, wallet or merchant lookup, order, payment or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/job-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/job-records/.
